item.title: Show HN: Scout – a self-hosted Discord AI memory bot
item.summary: Scout, a self-hosted Discord memory bot. Listens to the conversation and creates summaries and answers questions. Runs Qwen3 8B Instruct, in a 4-bit quantization, served locally through Ollama. It can answer questions about the conversation or generate summaries for when you missed out on the conversation.
